test_cases.title: Every external page loads with its expected heading
acs: DERIVED: Each surveyed external page loads with the heading recorded by the survey - 20 pages (data/pages.json)
assumptions: The external site runs at http://localhost:1688. 20 pages are listed in the Examples table.
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 20 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688 followed by the route of the page in the current row.

steps.expected: The h1 matches the heading recorded for that page (or the title when the page has no h1).

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

steps.action: Repeat for every row of the Examples table.
Look at the accessibility scan result for the page.
steps.expected: The page was scanned once and the result is in the accessibility report.

assumptions: Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
